parameters.name: EnableMicroRegistration
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to enable SAE built-in registry:

*   **true**
*   **false**

Default value: true. If you do not use the built-in registry, you can set this parameter to false to accelerate the creation of a namespace.

parameters.name: NameSpaceShortId
parameters.description: The trace ID that is used to query the details of the request.

parameters.name: NamespaceDescription
parameters.description: The message returned for the operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae create-namespace --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --namespace-name name --namespace-description desc --name-space-short-id test --enable-micro-registration true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sae POST /pop/v1/paas/namespace --region cn-hangzhou --NameSpaceShortId test --NamespaceName name --NamespaceId 'cn-beijing:test' --NamespaceDescription desc --EnableMicroRegistration true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
